tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind everything (Basalt in dark). Body text on it: text, text-muted, text-faint.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Header and sidebar ground, one step above canvas.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, widgets, menus, inputs (Slate in dark). text and text-muted pass 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and selected fill for rows, nav items and ghost buttons; meter tracks.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only, not for controls.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input, secondary-button and checkbox outlines; 3:1 against surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on any surface.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, descriptions, inactive nav labels (Stone in dark). 4.5:1 on all surfaces.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Timestamps, hints and placeholders. 4.5:1 on canvas, surface and surface-raised; never smaller than 12px.

tokens.name: brand-sand
tokens.usage: Sand: the mark's top slab and the brand accent. Fills, meters and highlights; as text use accent-text.

tokens.name: brand-stone
tokens.usage: Stone: the mark's middle slab; neutral icons and illustration.

tokens.name: brand-stone-deep
tokens.usage: The mark's bottom slab; the darkest illustration tone.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Sand as text: the Pi in the wordmark, active nav icon, small highlights. 4.5:1 on all surfaces.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill: Sand on dark, Basalt on light. One primary action per view.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: primary-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Sky: inline links and text actions. Not used for buttons.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring on every interactive element, offset 2px.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Moss: success and online fills (status dots, toasts). on-signal text on it.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Online / healthy as text and icons.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Ember: degraded and attention fills. on-warning text on it, never white.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Degraded / attention as text and icons.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Rust: errors, stopped services, destructive buttons. on-signal text on it.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Errors as text and icons.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on success and danger fills.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on warning fills (Basalt in both themes).

tokens.name: tint-sand-bg
tokens.usage: System category tile and badge ground (Dashboard, Auth, Notify, Recover, Car Thing; admin pages Health, Services, Users, Settings).

tokens.name: tint-sand-fg
tokens.usage: Icon on tint-sand-bg.

tokens.name: tint-moss-bg
tokens.usage: Planning category tile (EventTrakr, Pinboard); healthy badge ground.

tokens.name: tint-moss-fg
tokens.usage: Icon on tint-moss-bg.

tokens.name: tint-sky-bg
tokens.usage: Media and reading category tile (NewsCast, SportGuide, Library).

tokens.name: tint-sky-fg
tokens.usage: Icon on tint-sky-bg.

tokens.name: tint-ember-bg
tokens.usage: Shopping category tile (PriceScout, PriceWatch); degraded badge ground.

tokens.name: tint-ember-fg
tokens.usage: Icon on tint-ember-bg.

tokens.name: tint-rust-bg
tokens.usage: Error badge ground. Not used as an app category.

tokens.name: tint-rust-fg
tokens.usage: Icon and text on tint-rust-bg.

tokens.name: tint-stone-bg
tokens.usage: Unknown badge ground; neutral tiles. Not an app category.

tokens.name: tint-stone-fg
tokens.usage: Icon on tint-stone-bg.

tokens.name: tint-amethyst-bg
tokens.usage: Files and building category tile (FileServe, Studio).

tokens.name: tint-amethyst-fg
tokens.usage: Icon on tint-amethyst-bg.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card and widget titles, app names.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Header wordmark beside the mark; Pi in accent-text.

styles.name: body

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis, button labels at large size.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase overlines and widget labels. Set text-transform: uppercase.

tokens.usage: Card and widget padding; gap between sections' heading and content.

tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; space between sections.

tokens.name: space-7

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Header height.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges' inner chips, kbd keys, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items, icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and widgets.

tokens.name: radius-xl

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App icon tiles of the StonePi mark (squircle-like).

tokens.name: radius-pill
